summary: IDS feed s077_single shows 17.8% duplicate packets (736/4124) exceeding 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (VLANs, encryption, one-way, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy. Duplicates waste IDS capacity and risk false positives.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packets twice, typically from overlapping SPAN sessions or aggregating the same TAP feed via two paths without deduplication enabled.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes cycles re-analyzing 17.8% duplicate packets, inflates flow/alert counts, and reduces effective detection capacity for real threats despite needing full payload and bidirectional visibility.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets within a short window before delivery to the 1 Gbps IDS port, restoring capacity without losing unique traffic.
